name: Deore XT II two-finger brake-lever pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 284 g for the complete left/right BL-M733 two-finger brake-lever pair with 22.2 mm clamps. The listed weight applies specifically to the two-finger model, not the adjacent four-finger model; rubber-cover inclusion in the weight is not separately specified.
